title: Built for regulated
environments.
lead: Every desk works within defined authority, with human accountability and a record of what it did, so you can put AI to work without losing control.

ledger.label: Placement Desk
ledger.description: Placement Desk activity: work checked against its authority, decisions returned to a supervisor, and every action recorded

read.task: Read under scoped access: {account} loss runs from the AMS

escalated.task: Stopped for a decision: market list for {account} sent to the supervisor

approved.task: Supervisor approved the market list for {account}

emailed.task: Submitted by email on the approved list: {carrier}

blocked.task: Outside defined authority: {account} request returned to the supervisor

recorded.task: Recorded in the audit trail: {account}, inputs, decision and outcome

sides.title: AI only acts within defined limits.

items.title: Scoped authority
items.body: Set what it can do, where it can act and which work it can take on.

items.title: Access stays under your control
items.body: Narrow or remove access at any time without disrupting work that remains in scope.

items.title: Model-agnostic
items.body: Changes models by task when needed without changing the desk’s rules, controls or record.

items.title: Named supervision
items.body: Every desk has a named supervisor who owns the outcome and the calls AI shouldn’t make.

items.title: You decide where people step in
items.body: Set the points where the desk stops, returns the work and waits for a decision.

items.title: You are not handed a builder
items.body: Your desk comes with the right access, controls and reporting already configured.

items.title: Full audit trail
items.body: See what was done, through which channel and under whose authority.

items.title: Context stays intact
items.body: Keep the inputs, actions and outcomes together so any placement can be reviewed later.

items.title: Review performance
items.body: Track outcomes, exceptions and patterns against the standards you set.

data.title: Your data stays yours, and stays separate.

items.title: Isolated by customer
items.body: Each customer’s data is kept separate from every other customer’s.

items.title: Access stays under your control
items.body: Use your own single sign-on and role-based permissions.

items.title: Your content stays private
items.body: Prompts, documents and completions stay inside approved systems.

items.title: No model lock-in
items.body: Change models when needed without changing your controls or tying your data to one provider.

cta.title: Bring your compliance and IT teams to the first conversation.
cta.body: We’ll tackle the hard questions early and walk through access, controls, records and data separation with your compliance and IT teams.
